ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms tracked metrics, a regression budget and the ignore-failure flag are declared; it does not run CI.
offer: Compare stable performance metrics with an explicit regression budget in CI. A breached budget must fail visibly rather than becoming a decorative chart.

minimal.reason: List the metrics tracked in CI. Untracked metrics cannot regress visibly, so name each one.

mid.reason: Set the regression budget percent, at least 10. A budget that is too tight flakes, so choose a stable threshold.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring threshold failure to false. A breached budget must fail the build, otherwise it is a decorative chart.
